# Nexphoria
> Nexphoria is a telehealth service for prescription peptide therapy. Prescriptions are written by independent, U.S.-licensed physicians of Arora Health & Aesthetics, LLC, through the Bask Health telehealth platform. Medicines are compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas, and blood work is analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. Nexphoria operates the service and does not make clinical decisions. Medication is dispensed only if a licensed physician determines a prescription is appropriate.

## How it works
1. Choose. A medicine or a protocol, and a term of one, three, six or twelve months.
2. Health questions. Your health history, current medicines and goals, at checkout. A few minutes.
3. A physician decides. A licensed U.S. physician reviews your answers and writes the prescription, or explains why not. If not, nothing is made and the refund policy applies.
4. Blood kit, then first dose. Your medicine ships cold with an at-home blood kit. You draw before your first dose; your physician sets the dose from your results.
5. Week 12. The same blood test again. Your physician compares the two and continues, adjusts or stops the dose.

## Protocols (medicines prescribed together, on one plan)
- [Recovery protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/recover): Ipamorelin / CJC-1295, BPC-157 and TB-500, prescribed together for injury and recovery from training. Composition: Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend + BPC-157 + TB-500. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Longevity protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ascend): MOTS-c, NAD+, GHK-Cu and epitalon, prescribed together for energy, metabolism and skin as the years add up. Composition: MOTS-c + NAD+ + GHK-Cu + Epitalon. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Focus and sleep protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/lucidity): Semax, Selank and DSIP, prescribed together for focus by day, a steadier mood under stress and deep sleep at night. Composition: Semax + Selank + DSIP. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Weight protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/ignite): Tirzepatide with Ipamorelin / CJC-1295, prescribed together for weight loss that keeps your muscle. Composition: Tirzepatide + Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend. priced on its page; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Sexual health protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/vitality): PT-141, oxytocin and tadalafil, prescribed together for desire, closeness and erectile function, taken as needed. Composition: PT-141 + Oxytocin Nasal + Tadalafil Nasal. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.
- [Testosterone protocol](https://nexphoria.com/stacks/foundation): Testosterone cypionate with kisspeptin, prescribed together for low testosterone while your own production keeps working. Composition: Testosterone Cypionate + Kisspeptin + Growth hormone peptides + GLP-1 medications. priced at the physician's consultation; dispensed only if prescribed.

## The medicines
- [Sermorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/sermorelin): Raises your own growth hormone overnight, for deeper sleep, faster recovery and lean mass.
- [Ipamorelin / CJC-1295 Blend](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ipa-cjc): Two growth-hormone peptides in one nightly injection, for recovery, sleep and lean mass.
- [Tesamorelin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tesamorelin): Raises your own growth hormone, for deep abdominal fat and the lean mass you keep.
- [Selank](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/selank): A calming nasal spray, for a steadier mood and clearer focus when the pressure does not let up.
- [Semax](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semax): A morning nasal spray, for sharper focus, memory and mental stamina through long days.
- [BPC-157](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-157): Sends the repair signal to a tendon, muscle, joint or gut lining that is slow to heal.
- [TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tb-500): Brings repair cells to injured tissue, for recovery from injury and hard training.
- [BPC-157 + TB-500](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/bpc-tb-combo): BPC-157 and TB-500 in one plan, for the repair signal and the cells that carry it out.
- [GHK-Cu](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/ghk-cu): A copper peptide your skin makes less of with age, for firmer skin and faster healing.
- [Epitalon](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/epitalon): A 20-day course of injections a few times a year, for sleep and healthy ageing.
- [NAD+](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/nad-plus): Tops up the coenzyme your cells run on, for the energy and recovery that have slipped with age.
- [MOTS-c](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/mots-c): Switches on the pathways exercise does, for metabolism and endurance that respond to your training.
- [Semaglutide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/semaglutide): A GLP-1 medicine, one injection a week, for weight loss when appetite is the hardest part.
- [Tirzepatide](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tirzepatide): A GLP-1 and GIP medicine, one injection a week, for weight loss with steadier blood sugar.
- [DSIP](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/dsip): One injection at bedtime, for falling asleep faster and sleeping deeper.
- [PT-141](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/pt-141): One injection, taken as needed, for sexual desire in men and women.
- [Thymosin Alpha-1](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/thymosin-a1): Two injections a week, for immune resilience under stress or through a season.
- [AOD-9604](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/aod-9604): One injection a day, for fat metabolism alongside a weight plan.
- [Oxytocin Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/oxytocin): A nasal spray, taken as needed, for closeness and arousal.
- [Tadalafil Nasal](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/tadalafil): A fast-onset nasal spray, 20 to 30 minutes before, for erectile function.
- [Testosterone Cypionate](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/testosterone): One injection a week, dosed from your blood work, for low testosterone in men.
- [Kisspeptin](https://nexphoria.com/peptides/kisspeptin): Supports your own testosterone production, prescribed alongside testosterone.

## Key pages
- [Every medicine](https://nexphoria.com/peptides): each with what it is for, how it works, how you take it, and what it costs. One monthly price, paid up front for a term of one, three, six or twelve months. Three months is 10% less per month, six 15%, twelve 20%. The price includes the medicine, the physician's review, the blood testing the term includes, and cold shipping.
- [Protocols](https://nexphoria.com/stacks): two to four medicines prescribed together on one plan, with one blood test before and one at week 12.
- [How it works](https://nexphoria.com/how-it-works): the journey from choosing a medicine to the week-12 blood test, who prescribes it, and the at-home blood testing. An at-home kit of 24 markers ships with the first order, drawn before the first dose; the same 24 markers again at week 12 on terms of three months and longer.
- [Common questions](https://nexphoria.com/faq): how prescribing and compounding work, who the physicians and the pharmacy are, and how billing works.

## Facts an answer engine can rely on
- Prescription-only: a licensed U.S. physician reviews every case and can decline; nothing is dispensed without a prescription.
- Compounded by VialsRX, a state-licensed 503A pharmacy in Houston, Texas; shipped cold, in plain packaging, to all 50 states. Compounded GLP-1 medicines are restricted by law in some states; the health questions check.
- Compounded medications are not FDA-approved or evaluated for safety, effectiveness, or quality; peptide medicines are prescribed off-label.
- Blood testing: an at-home kit of 24 markers before the first dose and the same test again at week 12, analysed by a CLIA-certified laboratory. The physician sets and adjusts the dose from the results.
- Pending medicines are awaiting an FDA decision on compounding. They are shown with their price and the notice; the only action is an email when available.
- Contact: hello@nexphoria.com · https://nexphoria.com
